item.title: Olivia Rodrigo Rocks Primavera Sound 2026 With Surprise Set: Recap, Best Moments & Setlist
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to our podcast, where we dive into the latest music news and updates. I'm your host today, and we're coming to you live from the world of music festivals. Last night, something unexpected happened at Primavera Sound 2026 in Barcelona.
[Soft music transitions in the background]
Host: Pop-rock superstar Olivia Rodrigo made a surprise appearance at the festival, taking the stage at 10:20 p.m. local time. But was it really a surprise? Rodrigo had been hinting at a Primavera appearance on her social media earlier in the weekend, and some eagle-eyed festival attendees had already spotted a gap in the schedule that seemed perfect for a surprise guest.
[Music transitions to a slightly more upbeat tone]
Host: The festival organizers had also confirmed that a surprise set was planned for the final full day of the festival, but they kept the details under wraps. Rodrigo's appearance made sense, given that she has a new album, "You Seem Pretty Sad for a Girl So in Love", coming out this Friday. A surprise appearance at one of the world's most revered festivals was the perfect way to stay top-of-mind ahead of her release week.
[Music transitions back to a softer tone]
Host: Primavera Sound is one of the few festivals that still carries a certain level of cred, with a unique location and intentional lineup curation. Rodrigo's surprise appearance coincided with a set from '90s shoegaze legends My Bloody Valentine, creating a conflict of interest for many attendees.
[Music transitions to a slightly more dramatic tone]
Host: But there was another reason why Rodrigo's appearance at Primavera Sound made sense. She debuted a new song, "What's Wrong With Me", a duet with Robert Smith of The Cure. This collaboration is the culmination of Rodrigo's recent artistic infatuation with The Cure, which began last summer when she performed "Just Like Heaven" with Smith at Glastonbury.
[Outro music plays]
Host: That's all for today's episode. Thanks for tuning in to our podcast, and we'll catch you in the next one.
